name: Abominable Form
entries: The cultist revels in the ruination of its flesh, drawing power from its disturbing deformities.

entries.name: Deformity: Mutilated Flesh
entries: In order to obtain this vile feat, the cultist flayed, burned, or otherwise mutilated its flesh, turning them into a grotesque shadow of their former self. At least one of their body parts (such as a limb or their face) have been mutilated in this way; this mutilation can only be undone by {@spell heal} or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher.

entries.name: Disgusting Visage
entries: Creatures that can see the cultist have disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. Additionally, once per turn when the cultist hits a creature with a melee attack, they can force the target to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of the cultist until the end of the cultist's next turn.

entries.name: Unsightly Figure
entries: The cultist gains proficiency in the Intimidation skill, and its proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check made using the Intimidation skill.

name: Apostate
entries: The cultist's hatred of the gods cloaks it with potent resistance against their works.

entries.name: Divine Resilience
entries: When the cultist makes a saving throw to resist the effects of a spell cast by a cleric, paladin, druid, ranger, celestial, or some other divine source, it can add its proficiency bonus to the saving throw if it isn't proficient in the save.

entries.name: Inquisition Defier
entries: The cultist is immune to effects that allows other creatures to read its thoughts, determine whether it is lying, or know its alignment. Additionally, the cultist can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Chosen of Evil
entries: The cultist's naked devotion to wickedness causes dark powers to take an interest in its success and well-being.

entries.name: Commander of Evil
entries: The cultist can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of the cultist makes an attack roll or a saving throw (no reaction required). The creature can add a {@dice d4} to its roll provided it can hear and understand the cultist. This trait doesn't function while the cultist is {@condition incapacitated}.

entries.name: Unholy Protection
entries: The cultist can use its reaction to halve the damage that it takes from an attack, spell, or other effect.

name: Dark Knowledge
entries: The cultist uncovers a piece of forbidden lore or knowledge that allows it to tap into ancient powers of evil.

entries.name: Ancient Secrets
entries: If the cultist has the Spellcasting trait, it can choose one spell of 3rd level or lower. The cultist can cast that spell at its lowest level without using a spell slot.

entries.name: Dark Indulgence
entries: After the cultist makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, but before the outcome is determined, an additional {@dice d20} can be rolled. The cultist chooses which of the d20s rolled is used to determine the outcome. When it does so, it takes 12 ({@damage 5d4}) necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

name: Dark Speech
entries: The cultist learns a smattering of the language of truly dark power.

entries.name: Beguiling Influence
entries: The cultist gains proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills, and its proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check made using these skills.

entries.name: Harbringer of Destruction
entries: The cultist can use its action to force each creature within 60 feet of it that can hear the cultist to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} (cultist's choice) for 1 minute. A charmed or frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After using this action, the cultist takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

name: Dark Whispers
entries: By whispering foul utterances in the Dark Speech, the cultist can drive its enemies insane.

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The cultist must possess the {@boon Dark Speech|EdE} vile feat in order to obtain this vile feat.

entries.name: Distorted Visions {@recharge 5-6}
entries: As an action, the cultist can whisper words of incredible wickedness to form grotesque visions in the minds of those who hear it. Each creature within 30 feet of the cultist that can hear the cultist must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. While blinded, a creature is also {@condition incapacitated}. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After using this action, the cultist takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

name: Demonic Boon of The True Flame

ability.entry: Up to a +4 bonus to Strength

signatureSpells.entry: {@spell burning hands} (1st level), {@spell scorching ray} (2nd level), {@spell fireball} (3rd level)

entries: Followers of the the True Flame are typically the downtrodden and desperate; men who want to watch the world burn. Those who stare too long into the flames of madness gain the Ever-Burning Embers trait.

entries.name: Ever-Burning Embers
entries: When this creature dies, its body turns to faintly-smoldering black ash. Over the next week, provided the ash is not intentionally scattered (it magically resists natural weather effects), it reforms into a hollow husk reminiscent of the creature's living body. Once this process completes, the creature returns to life in its new form, and its type becomes undead if it was not already. In addition, the creature gains immunity to fire damage.

name: Eldritch Boon of Atrophy

ability.entry: Up to a -8 penalty to Charisma

entries: Those psychically corrupted by the presence of the infinite devourer are left soulless and raving, often bent on reducing those around them to fine particulate matter.

entries.name: To Dust
entries: As an action, this creature drains the moisture from a creature within its reach. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw (the DC for which is based on this creature's Intelligence score). Constructs and undead aren't affected, and plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. A creature takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Filthy Outburst
entries: The cultist shrieks a phrase in the Dark Speech to deafen those around it.

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The cultist must possess the {@boon Dark Speech|EdE} vile feat in order to obtain this vile feat.

entries.name: Booming Voice
entries: When the cultist speaks, its voice can boom up to five times louder than normal.

entries.name: Foul Scream {@recharge 5-6}
entries: As an action, the cultist can loose a blistering torrent of foul curses and wicked insults in the Dark Speech. Each creature within 60 feet of the cultist that can hear the cultist must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition deafened} for 1 minute. While deafened, a creature suffers disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After using this action, the cultist takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

name: Harvester of Souls
entries: When the cultist delivers a killing blow, it destroys both the flesh and the soul.

entries.name: Steal Life
entries: When the cultist reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it regains an amount of hit points equal to the cultist's Challenge Rating.

entries.name: Obliviation of Spirit
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the cultist dies, the cultist can use its reaction to annihilate its soul. That creature can't be revived by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

name: Insane Defiance
entries: The cultist adopts insanity as a shield to turn effects that target its mind against those around it.

entries.name: Defense of Madness
entries: The cultist is immune to being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

entries.name: Mind Shield
entries: In response to being targeted by a mind-affecting spell or effect, the cultist can use its reaction to retarget the effect to another creature of its choice, other than the caster or source of the ability, within the effect's range.

name: Lichloved
entries: By repeatedly consorting with the undead, the cultist gains dread powers.

entries.name: Undead Consortium
entries: Mindless undead see the cultist as an undead creature. Becoming more and more like an actual undead creature, the cultist gains immunity to necrotic and poison damage, as well as the {@condition poisoned} and {@condition paralyzed} conditions.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the cultist to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the cultist drops to 1 hit point instead.

name: Murderous Intent
entries: The cultist's enemies fear its savagery and inhumanity.

entries.name: Deadly Critical
entries: The cultist scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 and rolls the damage dice three times, instead of twice.

entries.name: Slaughter (1/Turn)
entries: If the cultist makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits a creature with it, the target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage. If the target is {@condition frightened}, {@condition incapacitated}, or surprised, the attack also becomes a critical hit.

name: Otherworldly Sight
entries: The cultist has mutilated its eyes or forehead in an attempt to see that which must remain unseen.

entries.name: Deformity: Eyes
entries: The cultist has drilled a hole in its forehead trying to add a third eye, or it has supernaturally scarred one of its regular eyes.

entries.name: Third Eye
entries: The cultist has truesight out to a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Ghostly Gaze
entries: The cultist can see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet; when it does so, it perceives objects as ghostly, transparent images.

name: Parasitic Host
entries: The cultist invites parasites into its body in exchange for a greater hardiness against diseases and poisons.

entries.name: Deformity: Parasites
entries: Parasites use the cultist's body as a nesting ground, creating holes and burrows on its skin and in its flesh as they feed and multiply. When the cultist dies, its body breaks apart into a {@creature swarm of insects} in the same space.

entries.name: Healthy Tissue
entries: The cultist is immune to poison and disease.

entries.name: Exude Parasites {@recharge 6}
entries: As a bonus action, the cultist can summon a {@creature swarm of insects} or a {@creature swarm of rot grubs|vgm} (cultist's choice), which exits its body and occupies its space. The swarm acts on its own initiative, and follows the cultist's verbal commands to the best of its ability.
